# Dirty Git Repository Finder GUI

This project is a Python GUI application that scans the user's home directory for Git repositories and identifies which ones have uncommitted changes (are "dirty").

## Project Structure
- Python application using tkinter for GUI
- Git status checking functionality
- Recursive directory scanning
- User-friendly interface for displaying results

## Development Guidelines
- Use Python 3.x with tkinter for cross-platform compatibility
- Implement proper error handling for git operations
- Provide clear visual feedback during scanning operations
- Display results in an organized, filterable format
